_note: The GATE job, not the training one. procs is 4 rather than job_rlv3.json's 2: that job runs PPO, which holds a model and its rollouts per worker, while this one only plays games, so the memory per worker is an env and an agent. Timing, measured on a 6-game local smoke at 3 procs (champ_h10 9s, rlv3_base 24s, rlv3_rec 40s): about 4.5h at 3 procs for four arms over 995 games, so 4 procs is the margin against a Kaggle CPU being slower than the dev box. THE GATE DOES NOT RESUME -- session_eval.json is produced only at the end, so a timeout loses the whole run rather than part of it; that is what the 3600s min_left_s on the stage guards.
